summary: Frontend retest of the iteration_305 fixes (Playwright 1920x1080, cm.aftersales and cm.coordinator accounts, real AI extraction, fictional TEST_p6_ seed). 4/4 fixes PASS. (1) SAVE TWICE: I imported sales invoice SI-P6-7701, clicked Use in Build Quote, then Build. Save 1 showed 'Quote AFS-2026-AA495 saved'. Save 2 showed the info toast 'Existing maintenance quote AFS-2026-AA495 reused'. The prefill banner stayed after both saves and went away only after Clear. DB check: exactly 1 crm2_afs_quotes row with that source_import_id (source=document_import), and no auto_estate quote was created for the customer. (2) CUSTOMER SEARCH: an invoice with an unknown customer showed 'not confidently identified — choose'. Typing 1 letter left the default list (202 options) unchanged. Typing 'TEST_p6_Kes' narrowed the list to the TEST_ customer. Choosing it set 'TEST_p6_Kestrel Leisure Trust (chosen by coordinator)', re-matched the lines (the line now shows '1 on register'), loaded the site and enabled Use in Build Quote. (3) VARIANT LINE: the Match column showed '—' plus buttons afs-aq-import-variant-3-TEST_p6_cfg-var1 (LED) and -var2 (Touch). The 'Include' option was disabled, the decision stayed 'Needs review' and Apply was disabled ('1 line(s) need a decision'). Clicking Touch showed 'Machine chosen', enabled and selected Include, and removed the buttons. The applied quote priced 'TEST_P6Cross Touch', so the chosen variant was used. (4) AGREEMENT signed by e-signature with signed_document_error: afs-ag-activate count is 0. Only the afs-ag-signed-doc-failed banner with Retry storage is shown, plus Back and Preview agreement. I did not click Retry: this was a seeded agreement with no stored document. The design is unchanged.

design_issues.screen: Build Quote — document import customer select
issues: Before searching, the default list (/crm/v2/companies?limit=200) shows many duplicate names in preview data, e.g. 'Pulse Fitness — Test Admin' about 150 times. Search is now the way to find a customer, so consider showing only the suggested candidates until 2+ letters are typed. Low priority.

With my fictional configs (no rate card), the result showed CANNOT AUTO QUOTE, 'RRP req.' on every line and £0, next to 'Resolve 0 exceptions — No exceptions — ready to review'. The headline and the exceptions panel disagree. This is probably caused by my seed data, but check that RRP_REQUIRED lines are listed as exceptions.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: limit the default customer list before searching; check that the exception count is consistent when lines show 'RRP req.'.
critical_code_review_comments: AftersalesApp.js is about 3450 lines. Split DocumentImportCard, AutoQuoteTab and the agreement detail into separate modules.
searchCo has no debounce or stale-response guard, so a slow earlier response can overwrite newer results.
